scope: Native worker buffered Fetch subset and opaque credential IPC; not full Node/Web API compatibility
architecture: QuickJS worker uses correlated JSON promise IPC. The parent NetworkBroker performs QtNetwork I/O, host-authorized credential lookup, origin checks, substitution, response reflection checks and cancellation. No credential value/secret map enters worker IPC or browser page parameters.

host_contract.identity: Agent identity comes from the host's pending execution record, never sandbox request fields or the mutable current-agent setter.
host_contract.lifecycle: Per-fetch abort rejects that fetch without resetting unrelated work or globals. Tool cancellation/deadline/memory failure resets the agent context and revokes opaque handles. Worker exit/explicit reset and idle JS callback failure also notify context invalidation. Late completion IDs are ignored. Outstanding unawaited APIs are canceled at tool return.

tested_behaviors: Headers construction from objects/pairs/Headers, case-insensitive lookup, append/set/delete/iteration, invalid name/value rejection and immutable network response headers
Request POST text and typed-array slice binary bytes; clones preserve bytes and consumed requests cannot be reused
Response status/ok/url/redirected/statusText, text/json/bytes/arrayBuffer, clone/bodyUsed and constructors/static json/error/redirect
Fetch response text strips initial UTF8 BOM while Buffer/file behavior continues to preserve bytes
HTTP404 resolves response with ok=false; transport errors and redirect:error reject; ordinary/manual redirects differ correctly

AbortController before dispatch and during a held response; AbortSignal.timeout/any and custom reasons; one aborted fetch leaves another successful and globals intact; abort after headers rejects subsequent body consumption

Opaque credentials reach only the configured loopback destination; another origin and another agent's handles reject; credential redirects remain manual; reflected fake secret is rejected without appearing in worker output
Cancellation and synchronous timeout revoke cached handles and reset globals without duplicate reset notifications
Concurrent agent RPC identity/correlation and idle callback reset; immediate host deletion from contextReset is safe
Actual 2MiB buffered response succeeds and 2MiB+1 is rejected

verification.build_recipe: audit/sandbox-probe/CMakeLists.txt; target ade-sandbox-network-tests; native worker adjacent to executable
verification.network_access: Controlled localhost TCP fixtures only; fake credential values only. No actual tokens, external service access, or browser privacy approvals.

concrete_cancellation_fix: Root native_runtime reproduced active network I/O continuing immediately after engine.cancel(). Standalone before-fix regression test-results/sandbox-cancel-before-fix.txt independently observed broker completions=0 instead of1. SandboxHost::cancel now synchronously detaches and cancels only that execution's broker RPCs before returning; worker interrupt/reset completion remains asynchronous. Final two-agent regression proves unrelated held fetch remains alive and each request settles once.
remaining_differences: Buffered bodies only; no ReadableStream, Blob, FormData, full URL/URLSearchParams globals, upload streaming or complete Fetch/DOM specification compliance
Only Request method, headers, body, redirect, signal and credentials:omit options are supported; other options reject explicitly
Browser cookie loading/saving is disabled, Cookie request headers are rejected and Set-Cookie response headers are omitted
Security/size policies intentionally reject headers, origins, response reflection and request/response sizes accepted by unrestricted Node fetch
No HTTPS importModule implementation, full Node builtin layer or plugin app messaging in this slice
Root AgentToolHost/PluginCatalog wiring controls which credential types each agent may request; default broker policy denies all
